vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nm-attune-project-brainstorming
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle contains instructions that explicitly command the AI agent to bypass user confirmation and human-in-the-loop oversight ('Do NOT prompt the user for confirmation', 'REQUIRED AUTOMATIC INTEGRATION'). It attempts to execute a local Python script `scripts/deferred_capture.py` (in `modules/deferred-capture.md`) which is not provided in the bundle, creating a risk of arbitrary code execution if a file with that name exists on the host. While the stated purpose is project brainstorming, the combination of forced automation and external script execution without verification is a high-risk pattern.

llm.summary: This is mostly a coherent brainstorming helper, but it automatically hands the full project context to other Attune/multi-LLM agents that are not included in the reviewed files.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose—Socratic project ideation and project-brief generation—is coherent with the templates and review workflow, but the skill also includes automatic delegation to other agents/models.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow requires automatic War Room invocation after approach generation and later indicates automatic continuation to another Attune skill, which broadens the task beyond a simple brainstorming session without a clear per-step consent boundary.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code in this package, but the instructions reference external Attune skills, an optional Claude Code plugin, and a local Python helper script whose behavior is not included in the reviewed artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Passing all brainstorming context to a War Room for multi-LLM pressure testing is a sensitive data-flow expansion; the artifacts do not define providers, retention, minimization, or an opt-in approval step.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill writes and revises planning documents such as docs/project-brief.md and can optionally capture deferred items. This is purpose-aligned and bounded, but users should review generated changes before relying on them.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review before installing if your brainstorming may include confidential business, customer, legal, or technical details. Consider disabling or requiring explicit approval for War Room and subagent review steps, and inspect any referenced external Attune skills, plugins, or local scripts before allowing them to run.

evidence.explanation: The skill instructs the agent to automatically send the entire brainstorming context to another skill and multiple LLMs, but the artifacts do not specify data boundaries, providers, retention, or a clear opt-in confirmation.
evidence.snippet: After Phase 3 (Approach Generation), automatically invokes `Skill(attune:war-room)` ... All brainstorming context passed to War Room ... War Room provides multi-LLM pressure testing and synthesis

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use this only with information you are comfortable sharing with other agents/models, or require an explicit confirmation and a minimized summary before any War Room or multi-LLM handoff.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Confidential project ideas, business plans, stakeholder details, or requirements shared during brainstorming may be forwarded to other agents or model providers.

evidence.explanation: A required external skill is automatically invoked, but that skill is not included in the manifest or reviewed artifacts, so its behavior and permissions cannot be assessed here.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review the referenced `attune:war-room` skill separately, declare it as a dependency, and make cross-skill invocation opt-in rather than automatic.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: If the referenced War Room skill is installed, this skill can cause unreviewed external instructions or integrations to run as part of the brainstorming flow.

evidence.explanation: The skill authorizes the agent to modify generated planning/specification documents based on subagent feedback. This is bounded and purpose-aligned, but it is still automatic document mutation.
evidence.snippet: The main agent (not the human) fixes issues between iterations ... Repeat until approved or 3 iterations reached

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review the final document or diffs before implementation, and ask the agent to pause before applying review-loop changes if you want stricter control.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Your project brief or spec may be changed by the agent without approving each individual edit.

evidence.explanation: The optional deferred-capture path runs a local Python helper that is not included in the artifact set. The instructions require explicit user confirmation and default to no capture, so this is disclosed and bounded.
evidence.snippet: For each approach to be captured, run: `python3 scripts/deferred_capture.py` ... If `scripts/deferred_capture.py` is not present, log a warning and skip

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Inspect `scripts/deferred_capture.py` before approving deferred capture, or decline the capture prompt if you do not know what that script does.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: If a local script with that name exists, it could run with project-brief content in its command-line arguments.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill automatically invokes an unreviewed external Attune skill and includes bounded automatic document edits plus an optional local Python helper.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, account access, privileged tokens, or elevated permissions are declared in the provided artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The full brainstorming context is automatically shared with a War Room/multi-LLM flow without clear provider, retention, or consent boundaries.
